parameters.name: AllowFallbackForContent
parameters.description: Indicates that clients outside of the boundary groups associated with a site system can fall back. Those clients can use this site system as a source location for content when no other site systems are available.

parameters.name: AllowPreStaging
parameters.description: Indicates that the distribution point can prestage contents.

parameters.name: AllowProxyTraffic
parameters.description: Enables the site system to use a proxy server when it connects to the internet.

parameters.name: AllowPxeResponse
parameters.description: Indicates that the distribution point can respond to PXE requests.

parameters.name: CertificateExpirationTimeUtc
parameters.description: Specifies, in UTC format, the date and time when the certificate expires.

parameters.name: CertificatePassword
parameters.description: Specifies, as a secure string, the password for a PKI client certificate.

parameters.name: CertificatePath
parameters.description: Specifies the import path for a PKI client certificate.

parameters.name: ClientConnectionType
parameters.description: Specifies the client connection type.

parameters.name: ContentMonitoringPriority
parameters.description: Specifies the content monitoring priority.

parameters.name: ContentValidationSchedule
parameters.description: Specifies a schedule token object that the distribution point uses to validate content on a scheduled basis. To create a schedule token object, use the New-CMSchedule cmdlet.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Specifies a description for the distribution point.

parameters.name: DisableWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: EnableAnonymous
parameters.description: Indicates that the distribution point permits anonymous connections from Configuration Manager clients to the content library.

parameters.name: EnableBranchCache
parameters.description: Indicates that clients that use Windows BranchCache are allowed to download content from an on-premises distribution point. Content downloads from cloud-based distribution points can always be shared by clients that use Windows BranchCache.

parameters.name: EnableContentValidation
parameters.description: Indicates that content validation is enabled for this distribution point.

parameters.name: EnableLedbat
parameters.description: Enable distribution points to use network congestion control with Windows LEDBAT. This feature can adjust the download speed to use the unused network bandwidth.

parameters.name: EnableMulticast
parameters.description: Indicates that multicast is enabled for this distribution point.

parameters.name: EnableNonWdsPxe
parameters.description: Indicates whether the Configuration Manager PXE responder is enabled on the distribution point. When you enable a PXE responder without Windows Deployment Service (WDS), Configuration Manager installs its PXE responder service on the distribution point. For more information, see enable PXE on the distribution point.

parameters.name: EnablePullDP
parameters.description: When set to $True, the distribution point is able to pull content from other distribution points.

parameters.name: EnablePxe
parameters.description: Indicates that PXE is enabled on the distribution point. When you enable PXE, Configuration Manager installs Windows Deployment Services on the server, if necessary. Windows Deployment Service is the service that performs the PXE boot to install operating systems. After you create the distribution point, Configuration Manager installs a provider in Windows Deployment Services that uses the PXE boot functions.

parameters.name: EnableScheduledMulticast
parameters.description: Indicates whether you can schedule when Configuration Manager deploys the operating system image from the distribution point.

parameters.name: EnableSsl
parameters.description: Indicates that SSL is enabled on this distribution point.

parameters.name: EnableUnknownComputerSupport
parameters.description: Indicates that support for unknown computers is enabled. Unknown computers are computers that aren't managed by Configuration Manager.

parameters.name: EndIPAddress
parameters.description: Specifies the ending IP address in a range of multicast addresses that Configuration Manager uses to send data to clients.

parameters.name: EndUdpPort
parameters.description: Specifies the ending UDP port in a range of multicast UDP ports that Configuration Manager uses to send data to clients.

parameters.name: Force
parameters.description: Use this parameter to add a duplicate certificate without asking for confirmation.

parameters.name: ForceWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: InputObject
parameters.description: Specify a site system server object to add the distribution point role. To get this object, use the Get-CMSiteSystemServer cmdlet.

parameters.name: InitialMPForLookup
parameters.description: It's required (and requires) when providing -PreferredMPEnabled parameter. It expects a string input that represents different lookup MPs separated by the * symbol. MPs are filtered based on the Site code of the DP, if the MP's site code is different, an error is thrown.

parameters.name: InstallInternetServer
parameters.description: Indicates that Configuration Manager installs and configures Internet Information Services (IIS) on the server if it isn't already installed. The distribution point role requires IIS.

parameters.name: MacAddressForRespondingPxeRequest
parameters.description: Specifies an array of MAC addresses that the distribution point uses to respond to PXE requests.

parameters.name: MinimumFreeSpaceMB
parameters.description: Specifies the amount of free space to reserve on each drive used by this distribution point. When this limit is reached, Configuration Manager chooses a different drive and continues the copy process to that drive. Content files can span multiple drives. Starting in version 2107, the default minimum free space changed from 50 MB to 500 MB.

parameters.name: MinimumSessionSize
parameters.description: Specifies how many client requests must be received before a scheduled multicast starts to deploy the operating system.

parameters.name: MulticastMaximumClientCount
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum number of clients that can download the operating system from this distribution point.

parameters.name: PreferredMPEnabled
parameters.description: It's a switch parameter. The presence of the parameter indicates that the dynamic MP usage is enabled. PXE has to be enabled on the Distribution Point before using this parameter.

parameters.name: PrimaryContentLibraryLocation
parameters.description: Specifies the primary content location. Configuration Manager copies content to the primary content location until the amount of free space reaches the value that you specified for the MinimumFreeSpaceMB parameter.

parameters.name: PrimaryPackageShareLocation
parameters.description: Specifies the primary package share location. Configuration Manager copies content to the primary package share location until the amount of free space reaches the value that you specified for the MinimumFreeSpaceMB parameter.

parameters.name: PxePassword
parameters.description: Specifies, as a secure string, the PXE password.

parameters.name: PxeServerResponseDelaySec
parameters.description: Specifies, in seconds, how long the distribution point delays before it responds to computer requests when you're using multiple PXE-enabled distribution points. By default, the Configuration Manager PXE service point responds first to network PXE requests.

parameters.name: SecondaryContentLibraryLocation
parameters.description: Specifies the secondary content location.

parameters.name: SecondaryPackageShareLocation
parameters.description: Specifies the secondary package share location.

parameters.name: SessionStartDelayMins
parameters.description: Specifies the number of minutes that Configuration Manager waits before it responds to the first deployment request.

parameters.name: SiteCode
parameters.description: Specify the three-character code for the site that hosts this site system role. Starting in version 2111, you can't specify the central administration site (CAS) for this parameter, which doesn't support any client-facing site system roles.

parameters.name: SiteSystemServerName
parameters.description: Specifies the name of a server to host a site system role.

parameters.name: SourceDistributionPoint
parameters.description: Specifies an array of distribution point sources from which this distribution point can pull content.

parameters.name: SourceDPRank
parameters.description: Specifies an array containing the priorities for the distribution point sources from which this distribution point can pull content. Source distribution points with the same priority are randomly selected.

parameters.name: StartIPAddress
parameters.description: Specifies the starting IP address in a range of multicast addresses that Configuration Manager uses to send data to clients.

parameters.name: StartUdpPort
parameters.description: Specifies the starting UDP port in a range of multicast UDP ports that Configuration Manager uses to send data to clients.

parameters.name: UserDeviceAffinity
parameters.description: Specifies how you want the distribution point to associate users with their devices for PXE deployments.

parameters.name: UserName
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the user that the distribution point uses to connect to the primary site database. Use the format domain\username.

parameters.name: Confirm
parameters.description: Prompts you for confirmation before running the cmdlet.

parameters.name: WhatIf
parameters.description: Shows what would happen if the cmdlet runs. The cmdlet doesn't run.

parameters.name: ApplicationId
parameters.description: Specify an array of application IDs to distribute. These IDs are GUIDs as strings. By default, Configuration Manager also distributes the content for dependent applications. To disable this behavior, use the DisableContentDependencyDetection parameter.

parameters.name: BootImageId
parameters.description: Specify an array of boot image IDs to distribute. For example, "XYZ00015".

parameters.name: BootImageName
parameters.description: Specify an array of boot image names to distribute.

parameters.description: Specify an array of Configuration Manager collection names. Use this collection to target the distribution points to which to distribute the content.

parameters.name: DeploymentPackageId
parameters.description: Specify an array of software update deployment package IDs to distribute. For example, "XYZ00016".

parameters.name: DeploymentPackageName

parameters.name: DisableContentDependencyDetection
parameters.description: Add this parameter to not automatically distribute content for dependent apps.

parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.description: Specify an array of legacy package names to distribute.

parameters.name: TaskSequenceId

parameters.name: AllowFallbackForContent
parameters.description: Indicates whether clients can use a fallback source location for content.

parameters.name: AllowPreStaging
parameters.description: Indicates whether the distribution point can pre-stage contents.

parameters.name: AllowRespondIncomingPxeRequest
parameters.description: Indicates whether the distribution point can respond to pre-boot execution environment (PXE) requests.

parameters.name: CertificateExpirationTimeUtc
parameters.description: Specifies the date and time when the certificate expires.

parameters.name: CertificatePassword
parameters.description: Specifies the password, as a secure string, for the public key infrastructure (PKI) client certificate for the distribution point.

parameters.name: CertificatePath
parameters.description: Specifies the import path for the PKI issued certificate that the distribution point uses.

parameters.name: ClientConnectionType
parameters.description: Specifies the client connection type. Valid values are: - Internet - InternetAndIntranet - Intranet

parameters.name: ContentValidationPriority
parameters.description: Specifies the content validation priority. Valid values are: - High - Highest - Low - Lowest - Medium The default value is Lowest.

parameters.name: DisableWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: EnableAnonymous
parameters.description: Indicates whether the distribution point permits anonymous connections from Configuration Manager clients to the content library.

parameters.name: EnableNonWdsPxe
parameters.description: Indicates whether the Configuration Manager PXE responder is enabled on the distribution point. When you enable a PXE responder without Windows Deployment Service (WDS), Configuration Manager installs its PXE responder service on the distribution point.

parameters.name: EnablePxeSupport
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable PXE on the distribution point. When you enable PXE, Configuration Manager installs Windows Deployment Services on the server, if required. Windows Deployment Service is the service that performs the PXE boot to install operating systems. After you create the distribution point, Configuration Manager installs a provider in Windows Deployment Services that uses the PXE boot functions.

parameters.name: EnableUnknownComputerSupport
parameters.description: Indicates whether support for unknown computers is enabled. Unknown computers are computers that are not managed by Configuration Manager.

parameters.name: ForceWhenDuplicateCertificate
parameters.description: Indicates whether Configuration Manager overwrites a duplicate certificate when you import a PKI client certificate for the distribution point.

parameters.name: ForceWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: InitiateConnection
parameters.description: Indicates whether the distribution point initiates the connection with the clients.

parameters.name: InstallationAccount
parameters.description: Specifies a Site System Installation Account. Configuration Manager 2007 Site Component Manager service uses Site System Installation Accounts to install, reinstall, uninstall, and configure site systems.

parameters.name: MacAddressForRespondingPxeRequest
parameters.description: Specifies an array of media access controller (MAC) addresses that the distribution point uses to respond to pre-boot execution environment (PXE) requests.

parameters.name: MinFreeSpaceMB
parameters.description: Specifies the amount of free space on a drive before Configuration Manager chooses a different drive and continues the copy process to that drive. Content files can span multiple drives.

parameters.name: PathForSavingMigratedPackage
parameters.description: Specifies the path for a copy of the migrated content.

parameters.name: PrimaryContentLibraryLocation
parameters.description: Specifies the primary content location. Configuration Manager copies content to the primary content location until the amount of free space reaches the value that you specified for the *MinFreeSpaceMB* parameter. Valid values are: - Automatic. - Drive letter from A: through Z:.

parameters.name: PrimaryPackageShareLocation
parameters.description: Specifies the primary package share location. Configuration Manager copies content to the primary package share location until the amount of free space reaches the value that you specified for the *MinFreeSpaceMB* parameter. Valid values are: - Automatic. - Drive letter from A: through Z:.

parameters.name: PublicFqdn
parameters.description: Specifies the fully qualified domain name (FQDN) of the site system server that hosts the distribution point.

parameters.name: SecondaryContentLibraryLocation
parameters.description: Specifies the secondary content location. Valid values are: - Automatic. - Drive letter from A: through Z:.

parameters.name: SecondaryPackageShareLocation
parameters.description: Specifies the secondary package share location. Valid values are: - Automatic. - Drive letter from A: through Z:.

parameters.name: UserDeviceAffinity
parameters.description: Specify how the distribution point associates users with the destination computer for PXE deployments. Valid values are: - AllowWithAutomaticApproval - AllowWithManualApproval - DoNotUse

parameters.name: ValidateContentSchedule
parameters.description: Specifies a CMSchedule object. A CMSchedule object defines the schedule for validating the integrity of content files on the distribution point. To create a CMSchedule object, use the New-CMSchedule cmdlet.
